title: validate after finished interacting
rule: Validate after the merchant finished interacting (not before). Overlap NN/g §7; Polar names it on the component.
pass_when: Validation runs after interaction with the field finishes, not while it is still being completed.
fail_when: Error shown before the merchant finished interacting.
overview: Validate a field only after the merchant finishes interacting with it.
apply_when: Inline validation on text fields and similar merchant inputs.
not_when: Showing errors before the merchant finished interacting with the field.
agent_hint: Run validation after interaction finishes; do not error mid-entry.
description: Validate after the merchant finished interacting with the field, not while entry is still in progress. Polar names this on the component; it overlaps NN/g timing guidance for when to show field errors. Pass when validation runs after interaction finishes. Fail when an error is shown before the merchant finished interacting, interrupting mid-entry with premature feedback.
do_not_claim: Deleting `forms.errors.inline_after_complete`; this is the Polar-named component row. Overlap with Forms 54: `forms.errors.inline_after_complete` (NN/g §7). Keep the named row; do not re-dump §7.
